answer.description: The answer to the question in one short paragraph, or the reason it cannot be answered.

condition.description: A stable code such as replicas.single, probe.missing, service.no-backends, limits.missing, exposure.loadbalancer, policy.unselected-pods, alert.missing, change.before-incident, or custom.<slug>.

evidence_for.description: Evidence ids that support the finding.

evidence_against.description: Evidence ids that contradict it, if any.

uncertainty.description: What is uncertain, in words; no percentages.

limitations.description: What could not be known or read, and why.

knowledge_used.description: Ids of knowledge notes or exceptions that shaped the conclusion.
